dependency_edges.handoff: The twenty profile series become GPR characterization inputs.
The same profile items become level and tendency similarity inputs.
Integrated profile similarity becomes the outcome compared with external factors.
Seven profile-derived criteria become the evaluation matrix.
A failed local GPR trace defines the short-term ARMA repair target.
Interstate similarity supplies the rationale and weights for look-aside refinement.
ARMA increments provide the local component of the hybrid.
GPR supplies the global component and long-term limit.
Hybrid 2025/2050 forecasts supply RC and production baselines.
Optimized targets feed action screening and the memorandum.
Sensitivity of b and c0 reopens hybrid parameter choice.
Penalty sensitivity reopens target ambition and feasibility.
